subject: Follow-up: admin activity export scoping and security questionnaire kickoff
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alan Pierce <alan@medicentral.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: admin activity export scoping and security questionnaire kickoff

Hi Alan —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our side and the immediate asks your team mentioned so we can coordinate next steps: 

- What we covered: Redwood serving runtime overview, per-request audit trails (admin actions + API request logs), prefix/KV caching behavior, and routing/fallback policy traces.
- Security/compliance asks you raised: SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA considerations (data residency + BAA), vendor security questionnaire intake, and exportability / immutability for admin/API logs.

Immediate next steps I can own:
1) Share a short capabilities brief that outlines the available audit records (admin change events, API request + response metadata, model selection/routing events, KV/prefix cache operations). See attached: redwood-audit-capabilities-summary.pdf.
2) Kick off your vendor security questionnaire — you can send the doc back to me and I’ll route to Rishi and Marissa for answers and evidence.
3) Provide a sample export schema and example (NDJSON & Parquet rows) and call out immutability / retention options. I’ve attached a schema example: sample-activity-export-schema.json.

Do we have an internal security meeting at MediCentral next week as you mentioned? If so, can Rishi join a 30-minute technical deep-dive with your security engineer to go over log semantics, retention, and the immutability story? Proposed times: Wed 5/26 or Thu 5/27 (PST).

Thanks — aiming to get the questionnaire and schema to you before your security sync.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood-audit-capabilities-summary.pdf, sample-activity-export-schema.json
From: Alan Pierce <alan@medicentral.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 19:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: admin activity export scoping and security questionnaire kickoff

Thanks, Soojin — appreciate the summary. A couple quick clarifications from our security team: 

- SOC 2: we need a copy of your latest SOC 2 (or an indication of target date if still in flight).
- GDPR/HIPAA: confirm whether Redwood supports a BAA and where logs can be kept (US-only vs EU regions).
- Immutability: our compliance team wants to understand write-once read-many (WORM) guarantees or equivalent for exported audit records and whether exports include tamper-evidence (checksums, signed manifests).
- Export formats: preferred are NDJSON or Parquet; can you provide a 1-2 row sample?

I’ve attached our vendor security questionnaire (vendor-sq-medcentral.docx). If possible, mark any fields that will require legal review or a BAA. Our security sync is Wed 5/26 at 10:30am PT — would like to have your responses (or a plan) before then.

Regards,
Alan Pierce
Director, Security & Compliance
MediCentral Health
alan@medicentral.com
 
Attachment: vendor-sq-medcentral.docx
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alan Pierce <alan@medicentral.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: admin activity export scoping and security questionnaire kickoff

On Tue, May 25, 2027 at 7:03 PM Alan Pierce <alan@medicentral.com> wrote:
> Thanks, Soojin — appreciate the summary. A couple quick clarifications from our security team: 
> 
> - SOC 2: we need a copy of your latest SOC 2 (or an indication of target date if still in flight).
> - GDPR/HIPAA: confirm whether Redwood supports a BAA and where logs can be kept (US-only vs EU regions).
> - Immutability: our compliance team wants to understand write-once read-many (WORM) guarantees or equivalent for exported audit records and whether exports include tamper-evidence (checksums, signed manifests).
> - Export formats: preferred are NDJSON or Parquet; can you provide a 1-2 row sample?

Alan — thanks for the clear ask. Quick answers up-front and we’ll follow with evidence and a technical deep-dive from Rishi: 

- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report covering security and availability (report issued Jan 2026). I’ll route a redacted copy to you via secure link; Rishi will flag anything that requires a nondisclosure channel.
- GDPR/HIPAA: Redwood supports EU regions for data residency and we offer a BAA for HIPAA-covered deployments on Dedicated/Private plans. We can discuss the BAA scope once procurement is engaged.
- Immutability & tamper evidence: exported audit records can be written to customer-controlled S3 with object-lock (governance mode) for WORM. For hosted exports we provide signed manifests and SHA256 checksums of each export bundle; we’ll show an example signed manifest in the deep-dive.
- Sample exports: attached schema includes a minimal NDJSON example (sample-activity-export-schema.json). We’ll produce a 2-row NDJSON sample showing admin.change and api.request events for your review.

Rishi / Marissa — can you pick 30 minutes tomorrow morning to walk Alan’s team through the export workflow and the signed-manifest process? Alan, if you can send the completed vendor questionnaire back by EOD today, we’ll aim to return answers + artifacts before your Wed 10:30am sync.

Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

Attachments: sample-activity-export-schema.json
From: Alan Pierce <alan@medicentral.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medicentral.com
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: admin activity export scoping and security questionnaire kickoff

Thanks all — this is helpful. I’ve uploaded the completed questionnaire (MedCentral_Security_Questionnaire_20270525.pdf) to our shared portal; I’ve also copied procurement to start the commercial side.

Next steps we agreed internally: 
- MediCentral to review SOC 2 redacted report (Soojin to share secure link). Due: 2027-05-28 EOD.
- Redwood to deliver 2-row NDJSON sample export + signed manifest example. Due: 2027-05-27 17:00 PT.
- 30-min technical deep-dive with Rishi + Marissa. Proposed time: Thu 5/27 4:00pm PT; please confirm availability.
- Procurement and Redwood commercial to sync after security alignment for BAA discussion.

I’m fine with WORM via S3 object-lock as long as we can see the signed manifest + checksum workflow demonstrated. Look forward to the sample.

Regards,
Alan
Director, Security & Compliance, MediCentral Health
alan@medicentral.com

Attachment: MedCentral_Security_Questionnaire_20270525.pdf
